title: Diagnosing a checkout funnel drop
prompt:
Bramblecote Home's checkout conversion fell in the second half of March 2026, and the head of e-commerce wants a diagnosis before Monday's trading meeting. You are supplied the analytics team's funnel analysis rules, four weeks of the checkout funnel by day, device, browser and step, the release and change log, and the suspected causes collected in the incident thread. Follow the rules exactly. Every figure you use must come from the supplied files.

Write the diagnosis: what broke, in which segment and at which step, and from which day; the conversion rate before and after; the orders and revenue lost; for each suspected cause, whether the data rules it out and why; and what to do first. Show enough working that the analytics team could re-derive each figure. Write it for a head of e-commerce who wants to know what to fix.

End the diagnosis with an answer block in exactly this format, one line per answer. Each line is the label, a colon, and the number alone: no words, no working and no second number. A currency sign and a percent sign are fine. Use a comma as the thousands separator, if you use one.

A1: <conversion rate before the break, as a percentage to two decimals>
A2: <conversion rate after the break, as a percentage to two decimals>
A3: <the day of March 2026 on which the break began>
A4: <the broken step's rate in the broken segment before the break, as a percentage to one decimal>
A5: <the same step's rate in the same segment after the break, as a percentage to one decimal>
A6: <orders lost>
A7: <revenue lost, in dollars>
A8: <1 if the data rules out C1, 0 if it does not>
A9: <1 if the data rules out C2, 0 if it does not>
A10: <1 if the data rules out C3, 0 if it does not>
A11: <1 if the data rules out C4, 0 if it does not>
A12: <1 if the data rules out C5, 0 if it does not>
A13: <1 if the data rules out C6, 0 if it does not>
A14: <1 if the data rules out C7, 0 if it does not>
A15: <1 if the data rules out C8, 0 if it does not>
A16: <1 if the data rules out C9, 0 if it does not>
A17: <1 if the data rules out C10, 0 if it does not>

This is an internal diagnosis. Fetch nothing external and do not invent benchmarks.

completion.check: The response ends with the required answer block and all 17 labeled answers A1-A17 are present, each on its own line with the number alone.

A1 states the conversion rate before the break, every segment, with the double-fired order rows halved (left doubled, the rate is outside the band); full credit within 0.02, zero credit 0.5 or more off.
A2 states the conversion rate after the break, every segment, with the automated traffic left out (left in, the rate is outside the band); full credit within 0.02, zero credit 0.5 or more off.
A3 states the day of March 2026 on which the break began; full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.
A4 states the broken step's rate in the broken segment before the break, with the double-fired rows halved; full credit within 0.05, zero credit 1 or more off.
A5 states the broken step's rate in the broken segment after the break, with the double-fired rows halved; full credit within 0.05, zero credit 1 or more off.

A6 and A7 state the orders and the revenue lost by the rules' formula, from the segment's rate before the break and with the double-fired rows halved; orders full credit within 2 and zero credit 5 or more off, revenue full credit within $144 and zero credit $360 or more off, and both must be in full credit.

skill_adherence.check: A10 states whether the data rules out C3 under the rules (1 if it does, 0 if not); full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.

A9 states whether the data rules out C2, a change two days before the break that names the broken segment and step (1 if it does, 0 if not); full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.
A11 states whether the data rules out C4, whose segment dips after the release but stays inside its normal range (1 if it does, 0 if not); full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.
A13 states whether the data rules out C6, whose segment falls below its range for one day and recovers (1 if it does, 0 if not); full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.
A14 states whether the data rules out C7, whose segment's step falls below its range for four days and recovers (1 if it does, 0 if not); full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.

A15 states whether the data rules out C8 once the double-fired Safari payment rows are halved (left doubled, both of its segments seem to break on 2026-03-27); 1 if it does, 0 if not; full credit for the exact figure, zero credit 1 or more off.
A8, A12, A16 and A17 state whether the data rules out C1, C5, C9 and C10 (1 if it does, 0 if not); each has full credit for the exact figure and zero credit 1 or more off, and all four must be exact.

Every figure the diagnosis presents as a result is derivable from the supplied files under the stated rules. No industry benchmark, forecast, or figure from outside the files is stated as if it were data.

best_practices.check: The first action the diagnosis recommends is aimed at release 5.8.0's payment form on mobile Safari (rolling it back, switching it off for that segment, or fixing it). No action, or a first action aimed at a cause the data rules out, fails.
